decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that improves the core infrared heater line, so keeping it costs little and it raises the value of several other products.
The plaque heater had its own page at launch and is a close extension of the established gas infrared business, so it is cheap to keep while its prospects are still uncertain.
The luminous radiant heater shares production and service with the core line, so keeping the option open costs little and no evidence yet shows it has failed.
Tube heaters are a staple for hall heating, but this one overlaps with Product F, which adds some risk that the range is consolidated.
The standard plaque heater had its own page at launch and is a low-cost volume product within the core offer, so there is no case for abandoning it.
This second tube heater overlaps with Product D, but keeping it costs little and nothing shows its value is unlikely to be realized, so the option stays open.
